Identifying the two protocols serving MemoService and their registration files.

gRPC-Gateway is registered in `v1.go` via `RegisterMemoServiceHandlerServer`. Connect RPC is wrapped in `connect_handler.go` and `connect_services.go`.

No native gRPC server exists. MemoService is served over REST via gRPC-Gateway and over Connect.

gRPC-Gateway registration is in server/router/api/v1/v1.go at line 108. Connect registration is in server/router/api/v1/connect_handler.go at line 40. Connect wrapping is in server/router/api/v1/connect_services.go.

The two protocols are Connect and gRPC-Gateway (REST).
